cast_plays_too_one: {{name}} plays too, as it is grouped with {{with}}.
cast_plays_too_other: {{names}} play too, as they are grouped with your rooms.
cast_leaves_group_one: {{name}} leaves its Sonos group until you stop.
cast_leaves_group_other: {{names}} leave their Sonos groups until you stop.
cast_music_restarts: Music in {{names}} starts again from the top.
warning_reconnecting: The companion has stopped answering. Thaumic Cast is asking again.
error_cast_failed: The cast did not start. Trying again costs nothing and sometimes works.
error_desktop_not_found: Nothing answered. Thaumic Cast needs the desktop app or a server running to reach the speakers; start one, then try again.
error_connection_lost: The companion stopped answering and has not started again, so the casts were stopped. Check it is running, then select Reconnect.
error_no_active_tab: There is no tab here that can be cast. Switch to the one making the noise, then press Cast.
error_no_speakers_selected: Choose a room to cast to.
error_max_sessions: {{max}} casts at once is the limit, other people's included, and this would be one more. Stop one first.
error_capture_denied: Your browser would not hand over this tab's audio, and its reason was not written down. Try another tab.
error_capture_denied_reason: Your browser would not hand over this tab's audio, and wrote its reason down: “{{reason}}” Try another tab.
error_playback_failed: The audio was offered and no speaker began playing it. Check they play from the Sonos app, then try again.
error_stop_tab_capture_first: A tab is still being cast, and browser-wide capture cannot run alongside it. Stop that cast first.
error_stop_browser_capture_first: The whole browser is still being cast, and tab capture cannot run alongside it. Stop that cast first.
error_server_error: The server answered, and the answer was an error. Look at its log, then select Connect again.
error_wrong_server: Something answered at that address, and it was not Thaumic Cast. Check the address and the port.
error_network_failed: Nothing usable came back from that address. Check the server is running, and that this is where it lives.
error_permission_needed: Your browser will not let the extension talk to that server until you say it may. Open Settings and select Connect.
error_permission_denied: Your browser asked whether the extension may talk to that server, and the answer was no. Select Connect to be asked again.
error_load_settings: The settings were not loaded. Reload this page.
error_save_settings: The settings were not saved. Try again.
error_codec_detection: Thaumic Cast could not find out which codecs this browser can encode. Reload this page to ask again.
error_codec_detection_failed: Thaumic Cast could not find out which codecs this browser can encode, and cannot send audio without one. Try again.
error_offscreen_unavailable: The part of the extension that does the listening did not answer. Try again.
error_unsupported_sample_rate: Your audio device runs at {{rate}} Hz, which Thaumic Cast cannot send. Set it to 48 kHz or 44.1 kHz in the system sound settings.
error_pcm_rate_unsupported: Your browser captured this tab at {{rate}} Hz, a rate Thaumic Cast cannot send as PCM. Under Settings, set Quality to Bespoke and choose another codec.
castbar_lead_capture_denied: Your browser kept this tab's audio
castbar_lead_offscreen_unavailable: The listening part did not answer
auto_stop_source_changed: {{name}} started playing something else, and it only plays one thing at a time.
auto_stop_stream_ended: The cast was stopped at the companion's end, not from here.
auto_stop_playback_stopped: {{name}} stopped playing the cast, for a reason this extension has no word for. Cast again.
auto_stop_speaker_stopped: {{name}} reported that it had stopped, and was taken at its word.
auto_stop_speaker_taken_over: Another cast was started on {{name}}, and the newer one gets it.
auto_stop_continuation_failed: {{name}} reached the end of one stretch of the cast and did not take up the next. Cast again.
auto_stop_capture_error: Audio capture failed partway, and a cast with nothing to send has nothing to do. Cast again.
auto_stop_process_exited: The browser process being captured ended, and took the audio with it. Cast again.
auto_stop_device_disconnected: The audio device was unplugged or swapped for another, and the cast had been listening to the old one. Cast again.
auto_stop_pcm_rate_changed: This tab's audio arrived at {{rate}} Hz, and the cast had already declared {{declared}} Hz. Cast again while the tab is playing.
auto_stop_pcm_rate_unsupported: This tab's audio arrived at {{rate}} Hz, a rate Thaumic Cast cannot send as PCM. Under Settings, set Quality to Bespoke and choose another codec.
speaker_removed_source_changed: {{name}} started playing something else, and it only plays one thing at a time. The cast carries on without it.
speaker_removed_playback_stopped: {{name}} stopped playing the cast, for a reason this extension has no word for. The cast carries on without it.
speaker_removed_speaker_stopped: {{name}} reported that it had stopped, and was taken at its word. The cast carries on without it.
speaker_removed_speaker_taken_over: Another cast was started on {{name}}, and the newer one gets it. This cast carries on without it.
speaker_removed_continuation_failed: {{name}} reached the end of one stretch of the cast and did not take up the next. The cast carries on without it.
picker_waiting: Rooms are listed here once the companion answers.
hidden_chosen_one: {{count}} chosen room is hidden by the search. It stays chosen.
hidden_chosen_other: {{count}} chosen rooms are hidden by the search. They stay chosen.
save_set: Save these rooms as a set
sets_section_hint: Kept on this device. Make one in the popup with Save these rooms as a set.
sets_empty_body: Choose some rooms in the popup and save them as a set. They turn up here, to be renamed or removed.
no_speakers_found: No speaker answered. Check they are switched on, and on the same network as the companion.
network.speakers_not_responding: The speakers were found, but nothing is getting back from them. That is nearly always a VPN or a firewall: pause it, or let Thaumic Cast through.
network.speakers_unreachable: The companion cannot reach any speaker. A VPN or a firewall is the usual cause: pause it, or let Thaumic Cast through.
volume_fixed_hint: fixed level; turn the amplifier instead
start_level_unknown: not known yet; starts no louder than {{limit}}
start_level_capped: Now {{now}}; starts at your limit of {{limit}}
notice_lead_not_found: No desktop app or server answered
notice_lead_server_error: The server answered with an error
notice_lead_wrong_server: That address is not Thaumic Cast
speaker_not_answering_text: It has dropped off the network, so it plays nothing. Check it is switched on, or remove it.
speaker_remedy_head_start: Raise the speaker head start to {{suggested}} ms.
hint_replace_source: Whatever the speaker is playing will stop.
hint_replace_cast: The cast already on this speaker will end.
server_auto_discover_hint: The extension looks on this computer for the desktop app or a server, as soon as this is chosen.
server_custom_url_hint: For a server on another machine, or an unusual port.
server_url_hint: Select Connect to check the address. It is saved only when Thaumic Cast answers. If Thaumic Cast is on another computer, your browser asks for your permission first.
server_url_missing: No server address is saved, so the extension is still looking on this machine. Enter the address and select Connect.
server_url_invalid: That is not an address Thaumic Cast can use. Addresses look like http://192.168.1.20:49400.
audio_mode_low_desc: The least network. For Wi-Fi that is already doing its best.
audio_mode_high_desc: Every bit, whether or not anyone can hear it.
audio_mode_custom_desc: Every choice is yours, and so is what follows from it.
audio_browser_capture_note: Browser-wide capture is on, and it casts PCM whatever is chosen here. The choice is kept for when browser-wide capture is off.
audio_combination_unsupported_custom: This browser will not encode that combination of codec, bitrate, sample rate and channels, so a tab cast set to it will not start. Change one of the four.
audio_combination_unsupported_preset: This browser will not encode what this Quality asks for, so a tab cast set to it will not start. Choose another.
audio_latency_quality: Let delay grow (up to a limit)
audio_latency_mode_hint: If this browser cannot send audio to the companion as fast as it arrives, something has to pay. Letting delay grow keeps the audio whole and plays it later, up to a limit, past which the oldest audio is dropped. Skipping ahead drops audio as it backs up, so the delay stays short and the gaps are heard. Takes effect when you next start a cast. Tab casts only.
audio_smoothing_hint: Audio is held briefly at the companion so the late pieces can catch up. Raise it if every speaker cuts out together; one speaker alone wants a longer speaker head start. Each step adds that much delay. Takes effect when you next start a cast. PCM casts only.
audio_smoothing_migrated: Smoothing is now one setting for every mode, so yours changed from {{from}} ms to {{to}} ms.
audio_frame_size_hint: How much audio the browser puts in each message to the companion. Larger frames use a little less CPU and add that much delay, and make no difference to the speakers' Wi-Fi. Takes effect when you next start a cast. PCM tab casts only.
audio_sample_rate_follows_capture_hint: PCM goes out at the rate the browser captures it, usually 48 kHz.
audio_head_start_value_desktop: {{value}} ms, set in the desktop app
audio_head_start_value_server: {{value}} ms, set in the server's config
audio_detecting_codecs: Asking the browser which codecs it can encode…
audio_no_codecs_detected: This browser offered no codec that Thaumic Cast can send.
appearance_theme_auto_desc: Light or dark, whichever the system is set to.
reset_all_hint: Every setting goes back to its default. The connection stays as it is.
about_companion_not_connected: Nothing connected. The extension can do very little on its own, and is doing it.
about_updates_store_hint: Your browser updates the extension by itself. This checks now.
about_updates_manual_hint: Opens the releases page. A copy loaded by hand never updates itself.
about_update_ready_casting: A newer version is ready. Restart once the casts end.
about_update_throttled: Checked a moment ago. Try again later.
version_old_lead: The companion is out of date
version_old_body: It is on v{{appVersion}}, and it may still work. If anything misbehaves, update it.
version_old_body_unknown: It is too old to say its version, and it may still work. If anything misbehaves, update it.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Thaumic Cast
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: A short tour. There is not much to see.
onboarding.welcome.body: Thaumic Cast sends the sound from your browser to your Sonos speakers.* The extension is the part where you press Cast. The rest is done by a companion, which the next step goes looking for.
onboarding.welcome.footnote: * Over your own network. It has not been told about any other.
onboarding.desktop.title: The companion
onboarding.desktop.subtitle: The half that talks to the speakers
onboarding.desktop.checking: Looking for the desktop app or a server…
onboarding.desktop.found: The companion answered. That is one half found, and you are holding the other.
onboarding.desktop.not_found: Nothing answered. The desktop app or a server is what delivers the audio to the speakers, and one of them must be running.
onboarding.desktop.download_prompt: Install the desktop app, or give the address of your server below.
onboarding.desktop.manual_hint: For a server on another machine, or an unusual port
onboarding.desktop.manual_connected: Connected. The address was the right one.
onboarding.speakers.title: The speakers
onboarding.speakers.subtitle: Finding out who is in
onboarding.speakers.none_found: The network was asked and no speaker answered. Check each one has power and is on the companion's network.
onboarding.ready.title: Ready to cast
onboarding.ready.subtitle: That was all of it
onboarding.ready.intro: Up to {{maxStreams}} tabs can cast at once. Most evenings need one.
onboarding.ready.performance_body: Best for music. The speakers play a little behind the browser, which a song will never find out about and a film will. For films, turn on video sync in Settings.
onboarding.ready.battery_warning: A laptop on battery saves power wherever it can, and the browser is one of the places. If the audio cuts out, plug it in.
video_sync_description: Plays each page's sound early by as much as the speakers play late, so a film's lips and words arrive together. Pages already open need a reload, and a cast of the whole browser cannot be synced. PCM casts only.
video_sync_next_cast: Takes effect when you next start a cast.
video_sync_needs_access: Video sync works inside each site's own player, so your browser has to let it onto every site. Until it does, video sync does nothing, and switching it on asks again.
keep_tab_audible_description: Plays the tab's audio back on this computer, too quietly to hear. Your browser throttles a silent tab, and a throttled tab sends audio late. Takes effect when you next start a cast.
keep_tab_audible_browser_capture_note: Browser-wide capture is on, and it takes no audio from the tab, so there is nothing here to keep awake. The choice is kept for when browser-wide capture is off.
start_ceiling_description: A cast starts at the level the room is already at, turned down to this if it is higher. Turn it up once the sound has started.
capture_mode_browser_description: Captures the whole browser instead of one tab, which avoids the gaps tab capture can produce. Every tab is then cast as one, including the one you forgot was playing, and always as PCM. Needs the desktop app on this computer, on Windows 10 21H2 or later. Takes effect when you next start a cast.
capture_mode_unavailable_server: The server cannot capture a browser. Only the desktop app can, and only on the machine the browser is on.
capture_mode_unavailable_desktop: The desktop app reports that it cannot capture this browser. It can capture one only on its own machine, on Windows 10 21H2 or later.
capture_mode_unavailable_companion: The companion reports that it cannot capture this browser.
capture_mode_untick: While this is ticked, a cast will not start. Untick it to cast from a tab instead.
capture_health_frame_drops_message: A cast's audio has been arriving with pieces missing. Browser-wide capture usually cures that, and it is in Settings.
capture_health_frame_drops_message_no_re: A cast's audio has been arriving with pieces missing, and the speakers can only play what reaches them.
speaker_notice_head_start_ran_out: {{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms, and a {{current}} ms head start lasts {{current}} ms. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
speaker_notice_head_start_ran_out_draine: {{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms, and what was left of its {{current}} ms head start did not stretch to it. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
speaker_notice_head_start_ran_out_off: {{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms and the speaker head start is off, so nothing had been put by for it. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
speaker_notice_head_start_close: {{name}} very nearly cut out: a {{stall}} ms Wi-Fi stall left it {{left}} ms of its {{current}} ms head start, which is not a margin. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
speaker_notice_head_start_close_off: {{name}} very nearly cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms with the speaker head start off, and it got through on what it happened to have. Set it to {{suggested}} ms.
speaker_notice_head_start_no_remedy: {{name}} cut out: the Wi-Fi stalled for {{stall}} ms, which is more than the longest head start can cover, and that makes it a matter of furniture. Move the speaker nearer the router, or give it an Ethernet cable.
speaker_notice_where_desktop: The speaker head start is in the desktop app, under Settings > Speakers, and a new value takes effect when the speaker next connects, such as when you restart the cast.
speaker_notice_where_server: On the server that setting is pcm_connect_burst_ms, in the config, which the server reads once, when it starts; restart the server, and the new value takes effect when the speaker next connects.
speaker_notice_where_fixed: The speaker head start is fixed by THAUMIC_PCM_CONNECT_BURST_MS on the machine where Thaumic Cast runs, and that is the only place it can be changed.
speaker_notice_where_unknown: The speaker head start is set wherever Thaumic Cast runs, and a new value takes effect when the speaker next connects.
speaker_notice_running_low: {{name}} has about {{left}} ms left in reserve, and when that goes, so does the sound.
speaker_notice_running_low_drift: The clock in {{name}} runs a little fast, and that is where the reserve has been going.
speaker_notice_drift_uncorrected: The clock in {{name}} runs a little fast, so it gets through audio quicker than audio arrives, and will run low in about {{minutes}} min.
speaker_notice_drift_saturated: The clock in {{name}} is further out than clock drift correction is permitted to correct, so it will run low in about {{minutes}} min.
speaker_notice_drift_turn_on_desktop: Turn on clock drift correction in the desktop app, under Settings > Speakers; it starts work when the speaker next connects.
speaker_notice_drift_turn_on_server: Set drift_compensation to on in the server's config and restart the server, which reads its config only when it starts; correction starts work when the speaker next connects.
speaker_notice_restart_refills: Stop the cast and start it again; that refills the reserve.
ingest_gaps_message_desktop_one: Audio from this browser reached the desktop app late once in the last minute, and every speaker had a gap to show for it. Raise smoothing to {{suggested}} ms.
ingest_gaps_message_desktop_other: Audio from this browser reached the desktop app late {{count}} times in the last minute, and every speaker had a gap to show for it. Raise smoothing to {{suggested}} ms.
ingest_gaps_message_server_one: Audio from this browser reached the server late once in the last minute, and every speaker had a gap to show for it. Raise smoothing to {{suggested}} ms.
ingest_gaps_message_server_other: Audio from this browser reached the server late {{count}} times in the last minute, and every speaker had a gap to show for it. Raise smoothing to {{suggested}} ms.
ingest_gaps_no_remedy_desktop: Audio from this browser reached the desktop app up to {{worst}} ms late, and smoothing does not stretch that far. A busy or sleeping computer does this, and so does Wi-Fi between this browser and the app. Give the computer less to do, or a cable.
ingest_gaps_no_remedy_server: Audio from this browser reached the server up to {{worst}} ms late, and smoothing does not stretch that far. Connect this computer or the server by Ethernet.
video_sync_reason_muxed: This player keeps sound and picture in one stream, so neither can go ahead of the other.
video_sync_reason_worker: This player works where the extension cannot reach.
video_sync_reason_format: This player's sound comes in a form that cannot be moved.
video_sync_reason_pcm_only: Only PCM casts keep good enough time. Under Settings, set Quality to Bespoke and choose PCM.
video_sync_reason_companion_old: The companion is too old to say how late the speakers play. Update it.
video_sync_reason_browser_capture: Video sync needs a cast of this tab, not of the whole browser.
video_sync_reason_reload: This page was open before video sync was on. Reload it.
video_sync_reason_not_web_page: Browser pages, the Web Store and local files are out of bounds to extensions, so video sync cannot reach this one.
video_sync_reason_no_access: Your browser has not let video sync onto websites. Switch it off and on again in Settings to be asked.
video_sync_reason_freeze: The video stuck, so the sound went back where it was.
video_sync_reason_live_edge: This broadcast is too near live to play the sound early.
